description: Multi-account WhatsApp warming-up / training bot on Baileys (TypeScript), one process per VPS. Pairing-code login per account (numbers stored in a local registry), an interactive console dashboard/menu (status, accounts, chat logs), accounts added from the console menu, auto-join of a target group from .env, bot-to-bot group conversations, active-hours scheduler, human-like reply delays, and a text-only AI chat backend (OpenAI-compatible: Groq / Gemini / OpenRouter / OpenAI).
name: bot-trainer
